infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Delivery Sync shares your location with dispatch while you have an active delivery, so customers can see your live position on their tracking page.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Delivery Sync shares your location with dispatch even while the app is in the background, so a customer's live tracking map keeps working while you're driving with the phone locked.
